name: Joo Ok
address: 22 W. 32nd St., 16th Fl., New York, NY, 10001
dinnerNote: Tasting menu, 12 courses, from 1 November 2026 ($280 until then)

menus.name: Tasting menu
menus.note: $295 from 1 November 2026. Wine pairing of seven drinks $250, or a seven-drink non-alcoholic pairing $150

bookingOpens: Online through SevenRooms, Monday to Saturday from 5:30pm. On 13 October 2026 dates up to 30 November were open and December was not yet released. If the booking page doesn't work on your device, call or email info@joo-ok.com.
cancellation: A non-refundable deposit of $200 per guest is taken when booking. Changes or cancellations within three days of the booking aren't refunded, and same-day cancellations or no-shows are charged the full menu price per guest.
groups: For seven or more guests, email info@joo-ok.com.
dressCode: Smart casual or elegant. No ripped jeans, athleisure or hats, and no open-toed sandals for men.
children: Children under 12 are not allowed in the restaurant.
duration: About two and a half hours (SevenRooms holds each table for 150 minutes).
